rv.q: Lombe delivers a tender, cosmic and cleverly unpredictable love story that will leave you wishing for a sequel.

Time-travel love story with thermonuclear charisma … Benedict Lombe’s multilayered romance benefits from the charm of its two leads at the Duke of York in London … Much excitement has preceded the transfer of Benedict Lombe’s nuanced, beautifully affecting love story from the Bush Theatre — only the third play by a black woman yet to have made...
